dramatic.two_seconds_before: orbits, close and counted. Before frame 1 we are already inside 'SMALL TABLES': the city was moving before the camera arrived, so the opening beat is a stimulus already in progress, not a cold start.

beats.verb: something in the world changes — the figure against earth, water, street lamp
beats.line: Find me at the harbor, at the small tables, watching.

beats.verb: the change is registered — the figure against person, building, street lamp
beats.line: The elders clutch their pearls and pray. Life has burned all my love stories — victory-less seasons.

beats.verb: the body/camera loads against the coming move — the figure against person, building, floor
beats.line: So I harvest the flowers instead — scarlet poppies, purple blossoms — and they become my power.

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — building against awning, floor
beats.line: Then, a distant window. She says: you

beats.verb: the body/camera loads against the coming move — building against floor, water
beats.line: Then, a distant window. She says: you

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — the figure against floor, water, earth
